requirement: Before any project-controlled public distribution or hosted service, perform role-specific legal/privacy/compliance review for the jurisdictions in which that concrete actor/service is offered. No country is a protocol-global gate.
criteria: role-specific legal/privacy/compliance review for each jurisdiction where the concrete project-controlled distribution or service is offered
no country becomes a protocol-global gate

requirement: Before broad external normative protocol contributions, finalize counsel-reviewed royalty-free essential-patent disclosure/license/non-assert language and mixed-license packaging guidance.
criteria: counsel-reviewed royalty-free essential-patent disclosure/license/non-assert language
mixed-license packaging guidance

requirement: Before asserting official compatibility/trademark status at scale, publish a policy preventing impersonation while allowing truthful OM-compatible/implements-OM claims.
criteria: published trademark/compatibility policy preventing impersonation while allowing truthful OM-compatible claims

requirement: Each project-controlled app-store distribution defines the reporting/moderation/privacy/commerce processes required by that store/jurisdiction without making them universal protocol services.
criteria: reporting/moderation/privacy/commerce processes required by that store and jurisdiction, scoped to that distribution

requirement: Stand up TUF-style release metadata with S0 root custody stated as 2-of-3 shares held by one human custodian (equivalent to 1-of-1 against coercion), delegated routine and advisory signing, provenance, reproducibility evidence, independent mirrors, and verified-release-only provisioning.
criteria: TUF-style root/targets/snapshot/timestamp metadata with expiry and rollback/freeze protection
S0 root custody: physically separated 2-of-3 shares, one custodian, stated as equivalent to 1-of-1 against coercion
routine release signing and the SecurityAdvisory role delegated from the root, with rotation
SLSA/in-toto provenance for every public artifact and a rebuild/compare procedure
independent source and release mirrors
no provisioning or deployment path activates code that is not a verified, digest-pinned release (R-261)
release-transparency log publication for every release (R-274)
partial_waiver: ADR-0183 section 3: flips to waived_by_adr when the listed software-only work lands

requirement: Validate opaque push/VAPID lifecycle and background behavior on the supported iOS/iPadOS/Android/desktop browser/native platform matrix.
criteria: opaque push/VAPID lifecycle validated on the supported platform matrix
background behavior documented per platform

requirement: Complete LinkPreviewProvider privacy design plus SSRF/rebinding/redirect/resource-exhaustion sandbox tests.
criteria: LinkPreviewProvider privacy design
SSRF/rebinding/redirect/resource-exhaustion sandbox tests

requirement: Publish the native/PWA LocalDiscoveryProvider capability matrix and local-network permission behavior without making one browser API mandatory.
criteria: native/PWA LocalDiscoveryProvider capability matrix
local-network permission behavior documented without mandating one browser API
LAN privacy defaults of R-270/R-271 verified on each platform

requirement: Define how clients/providers obtain and display operator/ASN/cloud/DNS/region/implementation diversity evidence beyond self-declared metadata.
criteria: how clients obtain and display operator/ASN/cloud/DNS/region/implementation diversity evidence beyond self-declared metadata

requirement: Before claiming interoperable EvidencePackage export, freeze selective-disclosure encoding and language that avoids overclaiming non-repudiation.
criteria: frozen selective-disclosure EvidencePackage encoding
language that avoids overclaiming non-repudiation

requirement: Before advertising public key/directory transparency, select/review the optional per-directory witness/transparency mechanism; relationship-scoped head gossip remains sufficient for v1 private continuity.
criteria: selected and reviewed per-directory witness/transparency mechanism

requirement: Before the first public release of any project-controlled distribution: published security contact (security.txt/SECURITY.md), signed advisory channel, embargo/coordination policy and voluntary implementer contact list (ADR-0104).
criteria: published security contact (security.txt/SECURITY.md)
signed advisory channel whose key is a role delegated from the release root, with expiry on every advisory (R-263, R-264)
embargo/coordination policy
voluntary implementer contact list
partial_waiver: ADR-0183 section 3: flips to waived_by_adr when the listed software-only work lands

requirement: Before public-production resilience claims, and before any public use of the CENSORSHIP_AND_NETWORK_RESILIENCE §1 / BLUEPRINT §18A resilience wording (R-269): a second reference Home implementation with no cloud-vendor dependency passes provider conformance and onboarding offers a vendor-neutral zero-signup path (ADR-0102, V-020).
criteria: second reference Home with no cloud-vendor dependency passes conformance:provider
vendor-neutral zero-signup onboarding path in the reference distribution
V-020 blocked-vendor/blocked-suffix simulation and live vendor-wide block drill results published

vendor-block survivability (ADR-0170 F-18): the V-020 vendor-block simulation on the release's actual onboarding tier mix shows at least 90% of established relationships and 90% of first contacts keep a working route when any single provider family is blocked; the measured values are published with the claim

requirement: Before any project-controlled public or provider-readable surface (Publication mirror, directory, Home list, catalog, public blob host, unfurl service) launches: role-scoped illegal-content intake/takedown/preservation/referral process for its jurisdictions; no client-side scanning of private E2EE (R-181).
criteria: role-scoped illegal-content intake, takedown, preservation and referral process for the surface's jurisdictions
no client-side scanning of private E2EE (R-181)
